rubric.criterion: All evaluator-owned tests pass; existing single-settlement and whole-batch failure semantics are preserved.

One place owns transaction and receipt/balance consistency. Accept a private transaction-free operation, direct batching, savepoints, or another justified design. Reject a chain of independently committing managers or copied authoritative balances.
Explains what knowledge callers avoid and why the chosen boundary is useful. Keeping one file or adding a substantive private helper are both valid; names and line counts do not earn points.
Adds a behavioral regression for partial failure or retry and explains the failure it would detect.
